description:
Extend `OctoPi.AI.Model` with `compat: map() | nil` (default nil). The compat map carries provider-specific knobs — the OpenAI provider uses it for the 16-field `OpenAICompletionsCompat` shape; other future providers will use it for their own shapes.

Tiny change, unblocks everything else.

Port map: §1.3
title: Add optional :compat field to OctoPi.AI.Model
